facts.en: Earned a computing diploma at Fictional Juniperbyte College in 2023.
facts.zh: 2023 年在虚构杜松字节学院获得计算机文凭。

facts.en: Paid junior front-end developer at Fictional Mossframe Digital from 2024-02 to 2026-08.
facts.zh: 2024-02 至 2026-08 在虚构苔框数字公司任有薪初级前端开发人员。

facts.en: Implements HTML, CSS and JavaScript changes from reviewed interface tickets.
facts.zh: 依据经审核的界面工单实施 HTML、CSS 及 JavaScript 修改。

facts.en: Added explicit form labels, visible focus styles and keyboard-operable disclosure buttons to client pages.
facts.zh: 为客户页面添加显式表单标签、可见的焦点样式及可用键盘操作的展开/收起按钮。

facts.en: Tests assigned pages using keyboard navigation and a screen reader, recording the browser and test steps.
facts.zh: 使用键盘导航及屏幕阅读器测试获分配页面，并记录浏览器及测试步骤。

facts.en: Triages automated accessibility warnings with a senior developer rather than treating every warning as a confirmed defect.
facts.zh: 与高级开发人员共同筛查自动化无障碍检测警告，而非将每条警告都视为已确认的缺陷。

facts.en: Worked on a team refresh of 12 public information pages in 2025-09.
facts.zh: 2025-09 参与团队对 12 个公共信息页面的更新。

facts.en: Personally implemented changes on 4 of those pages and reviewed keyboard test notes for 2 other pages.
facts.zh: 个人在其中 4 个页面实施修改，并审核另外 2 个页面的键盘测试记录。

facts.en: The team closed 28 tracked tickets during the refresh; the source does not assign all closures to the candidate.
facts.zh: 团队在更新期间关闭 28 个跟踪工单；资料未将全部关闭归因于候选人。

facts.en: A senior developer approved merges, and the delivery lead approved client release.
facts.zh: 高级开发人员批准合并，交付负责人批准向客户发布。

facts.en: Uses Git pull requests, browser developer tools and an issue tracker in the development workflow.
facts.zh: 在开发流程中使用 Git 拉取请求、浏览器开发者工具及问题跟踪系统。

facts.en: Writes concise test notes explaining the affected interaction and remaining limitations.
facts.zh: 撰写简洁测试记录，说明受影响交互及仍存限制。

facts.en: Completed an online introduction to inclusive interface design in 2024-07; it was not a professional certification.
facts.zh: 2024-07 完成在线包容性界面设计入门课程；该课程并非专业认证。

facts.en: Built a personal React reading-list app in 2023 with local browser storage and sample book titles.
facts.zh: 2023 年制作个人 React 阅读清单应用，使用浏览器本地存储及示例书名。

facts.en: That app had no server account system, payment flow or production client deployment.
facts.zh: 该应用没有服务端账户系统、支付流程或客户生产部署。

facts.en: Volunteered at Fictional Codeleaf Weekend Club from 2022-10 to 2023-06.
facts.zh: 2022-10 至 2023-06 在虚构代码叶周末社做志愿者。

facts.en: At the club, helped beginners trace simple HTML errors in supervised practice exercises.
facts.zh: 在该社协助初学者排查受监督练习中的简单 HTML 错误。

facts.en: Enjoys designing fictional board-game cards and playing casual table tennis.
facts.zh: 爱好设计虚构桌游卡牌及休闲乒乓球。

facts.en: Demonstrates completed ticket changes at internal fortnightly reviews.
facts.zh: 在内部每两周一次的评审中演示已完成工单修改。

facts.en: No responsibility for certifying an entire website against a formal accessibility standard is documented.
facts.zh: 未记录负责依据正式无障碍标准认证整个网站的职责。
